traps: all three dependencies are optional and none is in the default build: default = ["std"] and std only touches memchr if something else enabled it
Cargo.lock lists the optional crates anyway: the lock is resolved with every feature of the package, so being locked does not mean being built
itoa has an implicit feature named itoa (no dep:itoa anywhere); memchr and ryu have none, because dep: in fast and float suppresses it: --features memchr is an error
memchr?/std is a weak feature: it turns on memchr's std only when memchr is already enabled by fast
memchr = "2.7" is a caret range: 2.8.3 satisfies it
which functions exist depends on the features: int_text and float_text vanish from the default build, an indexer with default features misses them
